propositions: fsck and compact-all scan loops visit every ticket directory and are O(all tickets), dominated by archived cold tickets that should be skipped by default for maintenance performance.
archive operation must fold the ticket inline before writing ARCHIVED event with threshold=0 and horizon=0 to ensure just-archived tickets have complete SNAPSHOTs covering all events.

fsck and compact-all commands default to active-only scoping using .archived marker fast-path plus _is_net_archived confirmation, with --include-archived flag to restore full-walk behavior for audits and legacy tickets.
Reverted-archive tickets (stale marker without net-archived state) must never be skipped by default; the marker alone does not decide, confirmation step does.
Store-wide metrics (_check_json_validity, _check_create_events) walk all ticket directories regardless of --include-archived flag; the flag scopes only what findings are reported.
